THINGS_ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.title: Shifty Shop
THINGS_ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.INITI:
Two merchants share a crowded rug. One holds up a [gold]Relic[/gold]. The other [sine][purple]moulds a counterfeit[/purple][/sine] to match.

“Guaranteed genuine!”
“Twice your money back!”

They are busy applauding each other. Their wares and coin purse lie at the edge of the rug.
Fight [red]2 Fake Merchants[/red]. Obtain [blue]{TrueRelicsCount}[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold] on victory.
THINGS_ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKER:
You pocket a few pieces. The edges are soft. The weight is wrong.

[red][jitter]“My wares!”
“Our wares!”[/jitter][/red]

You slip away while they settle the matter.
THINGS_ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKEG:
You hook the purse. Both merchants turn at the sound of coins.

[red][jitter]“Weren't you watching the money?”
“I was watching you!”[/jitter][/red]

You leave the counterfeit shop with genuine gold.
THINGS_ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.BEGIN:
You place the original beside the counterfeit.

One merchant pushes the shelf behind him. The other blocks the exit.

[red][jitter]“Friend, let's not ruin our good name.”[/jitter][/red]
THINGS_ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKET:
Both merchants are gone. Counterfeits litter the floor, soft as underbaked dough.

The [gold]genuine Relics[/gold] they copied are still on the table, untouched.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.title: Stumble
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.descripti: The uneven stone path winds into the dark. Your boot catches on a raised stone. [jitter]THUD![/jitter] No ground rises to meet you. When you open your eyes, rows of humming lights stretch overhead. Yellowed walls repeat in every direction, each corner leading to another just like it. There are no windows. There is no end in sight.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.options.S: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. [blue]{SearchChance}%[/blue] chance to find the exit.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.descr: Corridor folds into corridor. The lights [gold][jitter]HUM[/jitter][/gold] overhead, yet your shadow always falls the same way. You scratch a mark into the wall. Around the next corner, the mark is already waiting. [red][sine]This place is learning you.[/sine][/red]
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.optio: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. [blue]{SearchChance}%[/blue] chance to find the exit.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.EXIT.description: At last, the wallpaper splits ahead, revealing a pale opening. Cold seeps from its left edge, and the cards at your side grow strangely light. From the right comes the sound of warm water. Straight ahead, you can almost smell the stone road. You have been here long enough.
You step into the gloom. Pale light seeps between your cards. Ink and paper [purple][sine]scatter into the air[/sine][/purple], then settle into unfamiliar shapes. On your next blink, your boots are back on the uneven stone road. The wall behind you is seamless.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.TAKE_ALMOND_WATER: You follow the sound of water into the opening. A cold bottle strikes your palm. You close your hand around it. The next instant drops you back onto the stone road, clutching water far too clear to be trusted. The label reads only: [gold]ALMOND[/gold].
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.REST.description: You sit against the wall, meaning to close your eyes for only a moment. The hum of the lights stretches thin and distant. When you wake, you are lying in the middle of the stone road. Your wounds have eased, but somewhere inside you feels [purple][sine]smaller[/sine][/purple]. You decide not to dwell on it.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.LEAVE.description: You shut your eyes and leap straight into the pale void. Weightlessness. You hit the stone road hard. Behind you stands only a cold, unbroken wall. Good enough.
THINGS_MEDUSA.title: Medusa
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.description:
You enter a gallery lined with statues. Every stone face wears the same surprised expression.

At the far end, a snake-haired woman is untangling one of her snakes.
“Eyes on the floor. Good.”
She slides an empty dish toward you.
“Now we can talk prices.”
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.RETURN_TO_OWNER.desc:
You set the [gold]Petrified Toad[/gold] in the dish. Every snake on her shoulders turns toward it.

“There you are.”
She plucks a lock of hair and drops it into your palm.
“Keep it. And mind the knots.”
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.OFFER_GOLD.descripti:
You put the coins in the dish and hand her your chosen card. She presses a finger to its corner.

The paper stiffens like stone.
“That should keep it from wandering off.”
You pocket the card. The dish is already empty.
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.GREET.description:
You give her a nod and leave the dish alone.

After a moment, she sighs and hands you a little bottle. The bottle, its stopper, even its bubbles are made of stone.
“A gift. Keep it away from your teeth.”
THINGS_CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.title: Cutting It Close
THINGS_CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.de:
The flagstone beneath your foot sinks.

[jitter]CLACK![/jitter]
A sawblade rolls around the bend ahead and comes straight for you. Its teeth scrape the stones, scattering sparks.

Walls on both sides. You reach for your cards...
THINGS_CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.op: Remove an [gold]Attack[/gold] card. Add [blue]2[/blue] copies [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Choose an Attack card to split.
THINGS_CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.ABORTED.de:
Before you can draw the card, the blade grazes your clothes and rolls past.

You stay against the wall until you can't hear it anymore.
You hold a card up to the teeth.

[jitter]RRRIP![/jitter]
Two scraps drift to your feet. When you pick them up, each has become a complete card. They feel much lighter.

The blade rolls on. You count your fingers. All there.
THINGS_CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.THROW.desc:
You throw a card into the teeth. Paper winds around the axle. The blade hops twice and stops at your feet.

You step carefully over it. It clatters again. You hurry on.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.title: Reality Aligned Houses
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.INIT:
The steps simply end. Grass stretches beneath an impossibly clean blue sky. Identical white houses line both sides of a road that runs beyond sight.

After a while, you pass the same blue mailbox. Not even the edges of the clouds have moved.

Inside is a letter in your handwriting:
[gold]“Welcome back. We kept a house for you.”[/gold]
Duplicate [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card in your deck. Become [red]Cursed[/red] — [gold]{Curse}[/gold].
Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. Remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card from your deck.
Take the Blue House's Back Door
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.HOME:
A card waits on the table. Even its creases match the one you chose.

You pocket it. Every chair in the house turns toward you.

Water drips beyond the door. You hurry through. The extra card weighs almost nothing. [purple]The thought of staying weighs much more.[/purple]
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ALIG:
You push the crooked frame into place.

The whole street clicks. Something is [red][jitter]squeezed out of you[/jitter][/red].

When the pain passes, a card is missing. What was it? You try to remember. Your teeth begin to ache again.

Never mind.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.BLUE:
You walk past the identical white porches and push through the blue back door.

A ladle of cool water sits in the shade. You take a drink and step back onto damp stone.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ABOR:
You stop. The plaque goes blank, and the houses slide back into place.

The blue house's back door is still open. For now, having no address will do.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.DEAT:
At last, you no longer have to walk.

Another white house appears on the horizon.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.INIT: Merge [blue]2[/blue] unupgraded, unenchanted copies into [green]1[/green] upgraded card.
Requires two matching, removable, unupgraded, unenchanted cards that can be upgraded.
Lose [red]{AddressMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Upgrade [blue]1[/blue] card and Enchant it with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
Requires an upgradable card that can receive [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
Lose [red]{RoadHpLoss}[/red] HP. Gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. You may keep walking.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.roadHint.d: The HP cost and Gold double each lap. Walk up to [blue]{MaximumLaps}[/blue] laps. You may leave after any lap.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.MERG: Choose the card to keep and upgrade.
Choose a matching card to fold away.

You take two identical door handles and pull them together.

The houses close like pages. No crash. Just a crisp [gold]click[/gold].

Your deck is thinner. The remaining card feels heavier. Looking down the road, you cannot tell which house is missing.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ADDR: Choose a card to upgrade and Enchant with Perfect Fit.

You write your name on the blank plaque. The pen slows, as though drawing its ink from somewhere inside you.

A chair scrapes against the floor. Someone has sat down for you.

You shuffle your cards. That one returns to the top. At last, it [gold]knows its way home[/gold].
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.LAP_:
You walk and walk. The sun does not move.

The blue mailbox returns. Inside is another letter addressed to you, its envelope full of coins.

[gold]“Well done. A little farther next time.”[/gold]

Still your handwriting.

The houses, lawns, and clouds fall perfectly back into place. Only your legs have changed. They hurt more.

The envelope is thicker.

This letter is short: [gold]“One more lap. Then you'll be home.”[/gold]
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ROAD:
You pocket the envelope and head for the blue house.

Behind you, the mailbox clicks shut.

You do not turn around. Some money can stay unearned.

On the third lap, only one envelope remains.

A figure is approaching along the distant road. It carries your pack.

You take the coins and hurry through the blue house's back door. The sky is still blue. You have seen enough of it.
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.title: Shadow Cloakroom
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.de:
A cloakroom is tucked into the cavern wall. Your shadow is already at the counter, tapping its fingers impatiently.

The clerk looks up from a row of empty hooks:

“Store one card for [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold—pressed neat before the Boss. Pay extra for a [gold]fresh cut[/gold], or take that coat nobody claimed.”
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.op: Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Store [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card. It returns [green]Upgraded[/green] before this Act's Boss.
You have already collected a claim ticket.
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.selectionPrompt: Store a card. It returns Upgraded before this Act's Boss.
The clerk takes the card by one corner and gives it a shake. It unfolds into a thin black coat, which goes on a hook behind the counter.

“You won't lose it?”

The clerk glances at your feet.

“Your shadow knows the way.”

You pocket the ticket. Your shadow seems a little lighter on the way out.
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.LEAVE.desc:
You beckon your shadow away. It taps the counter twice more before reluctantly settling beneath your feet.

The clerk puts the ticket away.

“Next time, arrive together.”
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.ABORTED.de:
You draw your hand back.

The clerk does not hurry you, simply turning the empty hook toward the next customer. Your shadow sighs.
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.title: Echoing Well
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.descri:
You drop a pebble down the well.

First rises the [aqua]ring of drawn steel[/aqua]. Only later comes the splash.

Two tiny jellyfish drape over a rim carved with [purple]Spiral[/purple] grooves. A glass bottle trembles beside them, waiting for your voice.
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.option: Remove [blue]1[/blue] non-X-cost Attack or Skill. Obtain [gold]Bottled Echo[/gold].
No eligible card, or you already own [gold]Bottled Echo[/gold].
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.selectionPrompt: Remove a non-X-cost Attack or Skill to bottle its echo.
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.RECORDED.descr:
The card vanishes past the rim without a splash. From below rises the sound of the next combat where you would have played it.

You catch the sound in the bottle. As the cork settles, it taps [gold]{Combats}[/gold] times.

The original card is gone.
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.LEAVE.descript:
You leave the bottle alone.

A few steps later, footsteps follow behind you.

One beat late.
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.ABORTED.descri:
You pull your hand back.

A small, hesitant sound rises from the well. The jellyfish keep waiting.
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.title: Polite Maw
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.descript:
The mouth spreads a napkin and pushes [gold]a potion, coins, and a relic[/gold] toward you, watching your deck.

[green]“Could you spare something to eat?”[/green]
Trade an Attack for a potion, or a Skill for Gold.
Trade a Power for a [gold]Relic[/gold], or feed it a [red]Curse[/red].
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.description:
The maw taps the menu with the tip of its tongue.

“Something crunchy gets a bottle of red. Something soft gets change.”

It polishes the little plate once more and waits.
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.ATT: {IsMultiplayer:Each player removes|Remove} [blue]1[/blue] Attack and {IsMultiplayer:receives|receive} an [gold]Attack Potion[/gold].
{IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Attack.|No removable Attacks.}
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.SKI: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Skill.|No removable Skills.}
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.descript:
The maw spits out a [gold]Relic[/gold] and wipes it with the napkin.

[green]“This, for something tastier.”[/green]

It pauses, then adds: [red]“Nothing bitter.”[/red]
{IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Power.|You have no removable Powers.}
Remove [blue]1[/blue] [red]Curse[/red]{IsMultiplayer: each, if able|}. [red]{IsMultiplayer:Everyone fights|Fight} the Maw![/red]
{IsMultiplayer:No player has a removable Curse.|You have no removable Curses.}
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.selection.CURSE: Choose a Curse to remove. A fight follows.
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.ATTACK.descripti:
The maw [jitter]crunches[/jitter] through the card and slides you the [gold]potion[/gold].

[green]“Much obliged!”[/green]

You decide to wipe the bottle first.
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.SKILL.descriptio:
It swallows the card in one gulp. A burp follows, along with a small pile of [gold]coins[/gold].

You pocket the money. It seems pleased with the deal, too.
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.POWER.descriptio:
The maw swallows the card, closes its eyes, and savors it.

You take [gold]{Relic}[/gold]. It is too distracted to say goodbye.
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.LEAVE.descriptio:
You shake your head. The maw sighs, but still waves its tongue at you.

[green]“Safe travels.”[/green]
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.ABORTED.descript:
You put the card away.

The maw looks at the empty plate, then at you. You decide to leave quickly.
{IsMultiplayer:Each player removes|Remove} [blue]1[/blue] Attack. {IsMultiplayer:Each receives|Obtain} an [gold]Attack Potion[/gold].
{IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Attack.|You have no removable Attacks.}
{IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Skill.|You have no removable Skills.}
THINGS_POLITE_MAW.pages.TIP.description:
The maw slides over a few [gold]coins[/gold].

[green]“Thank you for not stepping on me.”[/green]

You accept. It has a point.
{IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Power.|You have no removable Powers.}
Remove [blue]1[/blue] [red]Curse[/red]{IsMultiplayer: each, if able|}. [red]{IsMultiplayer:Everyone fights|Fight} the Maw![/red]
{IsMultiplayer:No player has a removable Curse.|You have no removable Curses.}
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.COINS.desc:
Your shadow fishes a few [gold]coins[/gold] out of a crack in the counter. The clerk makes no objection.

[green]“Finally. Someone claimed them.”[/green]
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.COINS.descript:
You collect a few [gold]coins[/gold] from the rim.

A clear voice thanks the well.

You had not spoken yet.
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.title: Mycelial Bank
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.descr:
Two mushrooms block the path. The thin one holds a ledger; the stout one hugs a jar of [red]red seeds[/red]. A thick root joins them.

[green]“Life is easily lost if you carry it around.”[/green] The thin one opens the book.

The stout one hides the jar behind its back. It looks good at keeping things.
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.optio: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP after each of the next [blue]{Payments}[/blue] combats.
Requires more than [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP and no previous deposit.
Lose [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP. Gain [green]{MaxHpReturn}[/green] Max HP after defeating this Act's Boss.
Requires more than [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP and no previous deposit.
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.SHORT.descrip:
Fine roots curl around your wrist. You feel tired. A few more [red]seeds[/red] appear in the jar.

The thin mushroom stamps a leaf.

[green]“Three installments. The roots will find you.”[/green]
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.LONG.descript:
A thick root draws something from your palm. The stout mushroom's cap swells a little wider.

[green]“Past the big door. Principal and interest.”[/green]

The thin one hands you the receipt and slaps its partner's hand away from the jar.
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.GIFT.descript:
The stout mushroom presses a handful of [gold]coins[/gold] into your hand.

[green]“A welcome gift!”[/green]

The thin one crosses out a line in the ledger and gives it a hard look.
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.DEATH.descrip:
Everything goes dark.

The thin mushroom stops writing. The stout one hugs the jar tighter.
THINGS_UNLIT_FIRE.title: The Unlit Fire
THINGS_UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.descript:
The logs have not caught, yet the ashes are warm. Sand climbs [sine]upward[/sine] inside a flipped hourglass.

A charred sign reads: [gold]“Open yesterday.”[/gold]

You hold out a hand. Warmth from an [orange]unreached campfire[/orange] ahead has arrived early.
Rest to heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP and [green]Smith[/green] now. You [red]cannot act[/red] at your next [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
Cannot act, no Rest Site ahead, or you already have an [gold]Ember Pact[/gold].
Rest now. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. You [red]cannot act[/red] at your next [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
[green]Smith[/green] now. You [red]cannot act[/red] at your next [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Heal an extra [green]{BonusHeal}[/green] HP on arrival at your next [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
Requires [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], a Rest Site ahead, and no existing [gold]Ember Pact[/gold].
THINGS_UNLIT_FIRE.pages.BORROW.descripti:
You sit beside the cold logs and let the warmth soak in—hot enough to hammer one card's edge bright before you drift off.

When you wake, the hourglass is empty. Far down the passage comes a soft [sine]puff[/sine], as though tomorrow's fire just went out.
THINGS_UNLIT_FIRE.pages.REST.description:
You sit beside the cold logs and soon fall asleep in their warmth.

When you wake, the hourglass is empty.

You dimly remember feeling cold the next time you came here.
THINGS_UNLIT_FIRE.pages.SMITH.descriptio:
The fire never catches, but the edges of your card glow.

You put it away. Far off, something softly goes out.
THINGS_UNLIT_FIRE.pages.FUEL.description:
You tuck the coins beneath the sign and bring over a bundle of dry wood.

The sand finally begins to fall downward.

Somewhere ahead, a warmer fire waits for you.
THINGS_UNLIT_FIRE.pages.CHARCOAL.descrip:
You leave the sign alone, rake back the crust of ash, and warm your hands over honest leftover heat.

Feels better. And nothing is owed.
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.title: Relic Workshop
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.desc:
You follow the hammering to a small bench. A beetle in goggles is splinting a snapped [gold]relic[/gold].

“Don't haul junk! Trade in for a tuned [gold]Uncommon[/gold], sell for coin, or borrow my anvil!”
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.opti: No Uncommon Relic is available for exchange.
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SELECT_TRADE:
The beetle clears a little space on the table.

“Let us see what you have.”
The beetle empties a heap of [gold]coins[/gold] onto the table and beckons toward your pack.

“Which one are you tired of?”
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.TRADED.descr:
The beetle inspects your old relic and pockets the [gold]coins[/gold], then slides [gold]{Offer}[/gold] smoothly across the grain.

“Sharp eye! Just finished calibrating every spring in that one.”
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SOLD.descrip:
The beetle snatches up the relic and presses a [gold]purse[/gold] into your hands.

“Just what I needed!”

You have barely left when you hear him taking it apart.
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.COINS.descri:
You wedge a stone under the wobbling table leg.

The beetle stops working and stares at it for a moment, then hands you a few [gold]coins[/gold].

“That works.”
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.title: Potion Tasting
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.INITIAL.desc:
A sweet smell leads you to a stall where an aproned newt stirs a bubbling pot beside [gold]brightly colored bottles[/gold].

“One is free! Buy two for a mug of broth, or trade me one of yours!”

It points at your belt.
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.INITIAL.opti: Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Procure [blue]2[/blue] random [gold]Potions[/gold] and heal [green]{BuyHeal}[/green] HP.
Lose [red]1[/red] [gold]Potion[/gold]. Procure [blue]2[/blue] random [gold]Potions[/gold] and gain [green]{BarterMaxHp}[/green] Max HP.
[green]“Pick one.”[/green]

The newt wipes the mouth of each bottle.
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_BUY.d:
The newt nudges the bottles closer.

Choose two, then pay [gold]{Gold} Gold[/gold].
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_BARTE:
The newt lines up the three bottles.

[green]“Pick the ones you want. Then show me yours.”[/green]
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.PAYMENT.desc:
The newt puts down its spoon and holds out a hand.

“Let me try yours.”
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.PAYMENT.opti: Procure [blue]2[/blue] random [gold]Potions[/gold] and gain [green]{BarterMaxHp}[/green] Max HP.
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.SAMPLED.desc:
The newt grabs a potion from the cupboard, wipes it on its apron, and presses it into your hand.

“Come back soon!”
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.BOUGHT.descr:
You put the [gold]coins[/gold] on the table. The newt pours a mug of steaming broth and hands over two fresh bottles.

“Do not mix them in one cup. Even I stopped testing after batch four.”
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.BARTERED.des:
The newt pops the cork, takes one deep sniff, and lights up.

[green]“Just what I needed!”[/green]
It swaps two bottles and throws in a ladle of thick cauldron stock.
THINGS_NARROW_GATE.title: Narrow Gate
THINGS_NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
You try to squeeze through a narrow stone door. The gap catches your pack and pulls out a few cards.

The face on the lintel opens its eyes.

“Too much luggage! Leave one.”
THINGS_NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.options: Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Pull up to [blue]{Candidates}[/blue] unseen cards (repeatable).
There are no other eligible cards.
THINGS_NARROW_GATE.pages.REROLLED.descri:
You slip [gold]coins[/gold] into the gap and turn the other way.

The door releases the first cards and catches a different set.

“These will do. Stop squirming!”
THINGS_NARROW_GATE.pages.REMOVED.descrip:
You let go of the card. The door swallows it with a click.

“Much better.”

The gap widens just enough for you to squeeze through.
THINGS_POTION_TASTING.pages.WATER.descri:
You shake your head. The newt shrugs and ladles a mug of hot kettle-broth.

Tastes strange, though it warms you up.
THINGS_NARROW_GATE.pages.REST.descriptio:
The door squeezes your pack for a while, but fails to extract anything.

You sit down to rest. By the time you stand, it has fallen asleep and the gap has loosened.
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.title: Biting Chest
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.pages.INITIAL.descri:
A half-open [gold]chest[/gold] crouches in the cave, a [gold]Rare Relic[/gold] glinting atop its coins.

You reach toward it. The lid snaps shut with a crisp [red][jitter]clack[/jitter][/red] of yellow teeth.

Some coins have spilled onto the floor. A wooden wedge lies beside them.
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.pages.INITIAL.option: [blue]{Chance}%[/blue]: Obtain a [gold]Rare Relic[/gold]. [red]{Chance}%[/red]: Lose [red]{BiteDamage}[/red] HP and become [red]Cursed[/red] — [purple]{Curse}[/purple].
No Relics of this rarity remain.
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.pages.RELIC.descript:
You snatch the relic and pull back before the teeth meet.

The chest sulkily chews a coin.
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.pages.BITTEN.descrip:
Your fingers close around the chest's tongue.

It persuades you to let go.
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.pages.WEDGED.descrip:
The wedge holds the lid open. The chest finds another angle and bites you anyway.

At least you leave with something.
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.pages.COINS.descript:
You pocket the coins on the floor.

The chest waits a moment, then slowly opens its mouth again.
THINGS_CROWDED_WARD.title: Crowded Ward
THINGS_CROWDED_WARD.pages.INITIAL.descri:
Every bed in the cave is occupied. A snail with lenses balanced on its eyestalks sticks bandages onto several bulging blankets.

It pats the only empty [gold]stretcher[/gold] with a tentacle.

“Room for one more. Do not touch the bottles.”
THINGS_CROWDED_WARD.pages.INITIAL.option: Heal [green]{LocalHeal}[/green] HP. Obtain [gold]Anesthetic Chart[/gold] (draw [red]{Cards}[/red] fewer cards Turn 1 for [red]{Combats}[/red] combats).
THINGS_CROWDED_WARD.pages.TREATED.descri:
The snail wraps you from top to bottom and gives you a mouthful of bitter medicine.

You stretch. The wounds are closed. One spot still aches.
THINGS_CROWDED_WARD.pages.ANESTHETIZED.d:
The pain fades. Your fingers seem to have gone with it.

The snail tucks a folded [gold]Anesthetic Chart[/gold] into your pocket.

“It will wear off soon.”
THINGS_CROWDED_WARD.pages.BANDAGES.descr:
You take a few rolls of bandages. The snail is already moving to the next bed.

Something grumbles beneath the blanket.
THINGS_CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.op: You have no Attack cards that can be split.
THINGS_RETURNS_COUNTER.title: Returns Counter
THINGS_RETURNS_COUNTER.loss: {character} was stamped alongside the slip at the [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_RETURNS_COUNTER.pages.INITIAL.des:
A waist-high wooden counter blocks a corner of the stone room, backed by cubbies stuffed with [sine]absurd excuses[/sine].

A brass stamp press, a narrow-slit [gold]bronze viewfinder[/gold], and a wire basket of today's returns rest along the counter.

Nobody tends it. Only a little cord-hung pendulum keeps swinging.
THINGS_RETURNS_COUNTER.pages.INITIAL.opt: Your Max HP is too low.
THINGS_RETURNS_COUNTER.pages.RECEIPT.des:
You pull the brass lever and punch yourself an official return slip. As the iron teeth [jitter]crunch[/jitter] through paper, your ribs ache in reply.

Well, it's stamped now. Even the Spire has to honor it.
THINGS_RETURNS_COUNTER.pages.RECEIPT.los: The press slams down far too hard, stamping you right alongside the slip.
It is bolted down tighter than it looks. You scrape your knuckles raw before wrenching the bronze frame free.

Looking through the slit, half the clutter disappears—leaving only the good stuff.
The clasp snaps shut with a crack, plunging the narrow slit into dark.
THINGS_RETURNS_COUNTER.pages.RUMMAGE.des:
You drop [gold]coins[/gold] into the wire basket and pocket the finest piece inside.

Whoever returned this clearly had too much Gold. Their loss.
THINGS_RETURNS_COUNTER.pages.LEAVE.descr: Somebody else's paperwork is none of your business. You step over the torn slips and walk on.
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.title: Hot Wax Box
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.loss: {character} was scalded by molten wax from the [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
A scorched smell drifts from a stone niche. A wooden box sits on the shelf with its [red]crimson wax seal[/red] still [red][jitter]blistering hot[/jitter][/red], ready to burst.

Crushed ice and a pry-bar wait beside it—abandoned express freight.
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.pages.INITIAL.options: Obtain [gold]Hot Wax Parcel[/gold] (win [blue]{UrgentCombats}[/blue] combats in [blue]{UrgentRooms}[/blue] rooms, or it bursts).
You are already carrying a wax parcel.
Too close to the Boss (fewer than [blue]2[/blue] rooms remain).
Pay [red]{ChilledCost}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Obtain [gold]Chilled Wax Parcel[/gold] (defeat an [gold]Elite[/gold] in [blue]{ChilledRooms}[/blue] rooms).
You are already carrying a wax parcel.
Too close to the Boss to reroute.
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.pages.ACCEPT_URGENT.d:
You wrap a sleeve round your hand and shove the hot box into your pack.

It [red][jitter]throbs like a live coal[/jitter][/red], urging you toward the nearest fight.
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.pages.RETAG_CHILLED.d:
You drop [gold]coins[/gold] in the trough and bury the wax under crushed ice. With a [aqua]sharp hiss[/aqua], frost freezes the latch shut.

More time now—though only an Elite bout will break frozen iron.
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.pages.PRY_OPEN.descri:
You jam the pry-bar under the clasp and heave! [orange][jitter]POP![/jitter][/orange] Boiling wax blisters your fingers in a shower of sparks.

Whatever sat inside is ruined, save for loose [gold]coins[/gold] and an intact [gold]Potion[/gold].
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.pages.PRY_OPEN.loss: When the iron clasp gives way, molten wax bursts straight into your face.
THINGS_HOT_WAX_BOX.pages.LEAVE.descripti: Someone else's rush delivery is not your problem. You push the box back and walk away.
THINGS_REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.loss: {character} stayed inside one of the white houses at [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.op: Pay [red]{SwapGold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card into a random [gold]Upgraded[/gold] card.
You have no cards that can be Transformed.
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.swapPrompt: Choose a card to Transform into a random Upgraded card.
You drop [gold]coins[/gold] onto the counter. Beneath it starts a [sine]brisk whir of unseen stitching[/sine].

Moments later, a newly tailored coat slides out. Your shadow checks its collar and nods.
THINGS_SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.CLAIM_LOST:
You lift the unclaimed coat from the far hook and shake a strange [gold]Colorless[/gold] card out of its lining.

Something behind the counter chuckles, yet lets you keep it.
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.option: None of your Basic Strikes or Defends can be Enchanted with [purple]Spiral[/purple].
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.spiralPrompt: Choose a Basic Strike or Defend to Enchant with Spiral.
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.SPIRAL.descrip: You drop the [gold]Gold[/gold] into the shaft. Echoes trace the carved grooves round and round until a glowing [purple]Spiral[/purple] settles on your card.
THINGS_ECHOING_WELL.pages.LISTEN.descrip:
You leave the bottle alone and rest by the cool stones.

Dripping water steadies your breath. When you walk away, footsteps follow up from the well—one beat late.
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.loss: {character} became a bad debt in the [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.SAMPLE_SEED.d:
The stout mushroom sneaks a warm [red]seed[/red] out of the jar and drops it into your palm.

[green]“Free sample! Off the ledger!”[/green]

Tastes like roasted soil, yet works surprisingly well. The thin one glares at the crunching, then grunts.
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.reforgePrompt: Choose a card to Transform on the beetle's anvil.
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.REFORGE.desc:
The beetle steps aside and lets you at his hot little anvil. [b][jitter]CLANG![/jitter][/b]

A few blows scatter the old markings into a brand-new card.
“Not bad,” he mutters, going right back to his screws.
THINGS_RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.REFORGE_REST:
You wedge a flat stone beneath the wobbling leg and sit for a minute.

The beetle pauses his hammer to inspect it. “Smart fix.”
THINGS_NARROW_GATE.pages.REROLLED_MORE.d:
You wedge more [gold]coins[/gold] into the crack and twist harder.

The gate spits those back and hooks up a fresh batch:

“Stop squirming or you'll round off my frame!”
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.pages.BITTEN.loss: Those teeth sank too deep. The lid snapped shut before you could yank free.
THINGS_BITING_CHEST.pages.WEDGED.loss: The wedge splinters in two. Only a few loose coins roll across the stone.
THINGS_WARM_ROYAL_CELL.title: Warm Royal Cell
THINGS_WARM_ROYAL_CELL.loss: {character} became another quiet lump of wax inside the [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_WARM_ROYAL_CELL.pages.INITIAL.des:
Behind wax walls, two [orange]amber royal cocoons[/orange] throb to a [sine]low hum of wings[/sine].

Thick jelly pools inside the stone basin. Plump [gold]worker grubs[/gold] cling along the ledge, watching you without moving.

Lowest of all gleams a warm [gold]Amber Comb Core[/gold], choked in sticky wax.
THINGS_WARM_ROYAL_CELL.pages.INITIAL.opt: Heal [green]{JellyHeal}[/green] HP. Gain [green]{MaxHp}[/green] Max HP. Add [red]{JellyBeeswax}[/red] [red]Sticky Beeswax[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Lose [red]{ReforgeDamage}[/red] HP. [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]{ReforgeCards}[/blue] random Basic [gold]Strikes[/gold] or [gold]Defends[/gold] into [gold]Common[/gold] cards.
You have no Basic [gold]Strikes[/gold] or [gold]Defends[/gold] to [gold]Transform[/gold].
Obtain [gold]Amber Comb Core[/gold]. Add [red]{CoreBeeswax}[/red] [red]Sticky Beeswax[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
THINGS_WARM_ROYAL_CELL.pages.EAT_JELLY.d:
You scoop out a slab of warm jelly and gobble it down, wax and all. A [green]bittersweet heat[/green] knits your wounds shut.

A few stubborn threads of raw wax stay stuck to your fingers.
THINGS_WARM_ROYAL_CELL.pages.REFORGE.des:
A grub nips your fingers sharp, drags your worn cards into hot wax, and kneads them flat.

Out from the cooling shells come plain [gold]Common[/gold] cards. Rough around the edges, yet solid.
THINGS_WARM_ROYAL_CELL.pages.REFORGE.los: Their bites sink deeper than expected. [sine]Sweet heat soon swallows the chamber.[/sine]
THINGS_WARM_ROYAL_CELL.pages.TAKE_CORE.d:
You wrench the [orange][jitter]humming[/jitter][/orange] [gold]Amber Comb Core[/gold] loose, dragging gummy threads across your pack.

A row of grub antennae tilt toward you in silence, then return to patching the torn wax.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.title: The Splice Booth
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.overclockPrompt: Choose an unenchanted card costing 2 or more to Enchant with Overclocked.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.rewirePrompt: Choose 2 non-Curse cards to Transform into random Upgraded cards of the same rarity.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.INITIAL.descri:
A squat iron switchboard leans against the wet stone. Behind its cracked glass, filaments [aqua][jitter]glow white-hot[/jitter][/aqua] while a red needle chatters against the [red][jitter]danger pin[/jitter][/red].

Two cloth-wrapped jumper cables dangle outside with brass clamps—yanked straight off some overworked machine.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.INITIAL.option: Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP. [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card costing [blue]2[/blue] or more with [purple]Overclocked[/purple].
Your Max HP is too low.
None of your cards costing [blue]2[/blue] or more can be [purple]Enchanted[/purple].
Lose [red]{RewireDamage}[/red] HP. Choose [blue]{RewireCards}[/blue] non-Curse cards to [gold]Transform[/gold] into [gold]Upgraded[/gold] cards of the same rarity.
Requires at least [blue]{RewireCards}[/blue] transformable non-Curse cards.
No Upgraded cards to salvage. Leave.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.OVERCLOCK.desc:
The brass teeth clamp your card, sending a [red][jitter]sharp crimson jolt[/jitter][/red] up your wrist! The card scorches thin, its cost dropping down by one.

Every play will likely sting for blood.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.OVERCLOCK.loss: The breaker slams shut. A vicious back-surge stops your heart before the sparks fade.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.REWIRE.descrip:
You clamp two cards side by side and throw the lever. [aqua][jitter]ZAP!![/jitter][/aqua] Sparks char your sleeve in a cloud of smoke.

Two unfamiliar [gold]Upgraded[/gold] cards slide out of the tray, still hot to the touch.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.REWIRE.loss: Both bare clamps whip straight into your palms. Every filament inside goes dark.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.SALVAGE.descri:
Pinching a scorched corner, you pull out a warm coil of copper braid. The card dims at once, yet a tidy heap of [gold]Gold[/gold] rattles into the tray.

Not glamorous, but coin is coin.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.LEAVE.descript: The red needle keeps hammering behind the glass, yet you carry nothing worth stripping. You shut the iron door and walk on.
THINGS_SPLICE_BOOTH.pages.ABORTED.descri: You pull your hand back from the live clamps. Inside the booth, the filaments subside to an [sine]empty hum[/sine].
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.title: The Gilded Press
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.loss: {character} became another flat sheet of leaf beneath [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.sealPrompt: Choose a card to Enchant with Royally Approved.
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.moldPrompt: Choose a card to Enchant with Clone.
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.pages.INITIAL.descri:
A jammed brass gilding press sits in the corner. Though its rollers stand still, glossy violet-gold ink keeps oozing onto the flagstones.

A wind-up bronze stamp taps [jitter]clack, clack[/jitter] against the tabletop on its own.

Flattened gold scraps and a warm wax mold rest beside the ink pan.
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.pages.INITIAL.option: Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP. [gold]Enchant[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card with [purple]Royally Approved[/purple].
Your Max HP is too low.
No Attack or Skill can be Enchanted with [purple]Royally Approved[/purple].
No eligible card can be Enchanted with [purple]Clone[/purple].
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.pages.SEAL.descripti:
The brass platen slams shut, chilling your knuckles to the bone as [gold]molten leaf[/gold] locks round the edges of your card.

The clockwork stamp stops, apparently satisfied.
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.pages.SEAL.loss: The rollers fail to halt on the downstroke, leaving only fresh gold foil behind.
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.pages.WAX_MOLD.descr:
You feed in the [gold]coins[/gold]. The brass stamper hops into the warm wax tray and strikes down once—[gold]CLACK![/gold]

Your card now bears a crisp template groove, waiting for a [orange]Campfire[/orange].
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.pages.SCRAPE_GOLD.de:
You leave the machine alone and scrape a tidy pinch of dried [gold]gold leaf[/gold] off the table edge.

The tiny bronze stamp bangs twice at thin air in protest.
THINGS_GILDED_PRESS.pages.ABORTED.descri: You pull your card back while thick ink goes on dripping quietly into the cracks.
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.title: Crooked Counterweight
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.loss: {character} ended up on the wrong pan of [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.weightPromp: Choose an Attack or Block card to Enchant with Weighted.
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.watchPrompt: Choose a card to Enchant with Slumbering Essence.
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.pages.INITI:
A rusted brass scale tilts hopelessly to one side on the stone plinth. Perched on the raised tray sits a handless bronze pocket-watch; dragging the low tray down is a black-iron counterweight.

A few metal balancing shims lie scattered near the base.

Neither pan looks [sine]remotely honest[/sine], yet the beam holds dead level enough.
Lose [red]{WeightDamage}[/red] HP. [gold]Enchant[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] Attack or Block card with [purple]Weighted[/purple].
No eligible Attack or Block card can be Enchanted with [purple]Weighted[/purple].
Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP. [gold]Enchant[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card with [purple]Slumbering Essence[/purple].
Your Max HP is too low.
No card can be Enchanted with [purple]Slumbering Essence[/purple].
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.pages.WEIGH: The iron block weighs far more than it looks, chafing your palm raw as you strap it onto a card. The parchment dips heavily—solid enough to dent stone.
The weighted pan swings down across your ribs. Both sides finally balance.
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.pages.WATCH:
With one final tick, a pale drift of mist slips out of the casing and settles into your card.

The empty brass pan swings twice, then falls still.
A gear inside winds backward with your pulse, and nothing remains.
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.pages.SHIM_:
You pry a flat brass shim from beneath the foot and tap a worn card straight.

Works well enough.
Tucked beneath the scale tray is half a tin of salve. Good enough for scraped knuckles.
THINGS_CROOKED_COUNTERWEIGHT.pages.ABORT: You pull away and leave the crooked scale undisturbed.
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.title: Ant Sorting Table
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.cullFirstPrompt: Choose the first copy to scrap (2 matching cards will be removed).
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.cullSecondPromp: Choose the matching copy to scrap together.
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.gluePrompt: Choose a Defend card to Enchant with Goopy.
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.pages.INITIAL.d:
Two [orange]soldier ants[/orange] with brass calipers crowd the chitin sorting bench beside a pot of glistening [green]chitin glaze[/green]. Scrapped duplicates already fill a basket below.

The larger one raps its pincers against the table and eyes your bulging deck:

“Carrying spares? We bite pairs in half. Pay up if you just want armor paste.”
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.pages.INITIAL.o: Lose [red]{CullDamage}[/red] HP. Choose and [red]Remove[/red] [blue]2[/blue] matching copies.
Requires 2 removable copies of the same card.
None of your [gold]Defend[/gold] cards can be Enchanted with [purple]Goopy[/purple].
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.pages.CULL.desc:
Its mandibles nearly take your wrist too! [red][jitter]SNAP! SNAP![/jitter][/red] Both identical cards are shredded flat into the scrap tray.

Once the sting fades, your pack feels noticeably lighter.
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.pages.CULL.loss: The calipers miss the margin and clamp straight through your wrist.
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.pages.GLUE.desc:
You set down the [gold]coins[/gold]. One worker smears a sticky teal lacquer neatly across your [gold]Defend[/gold].

It hardens fast—and feels thicker each time you flex it.
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.pages.POWDER.de: While the workers bicker over tallies, you scoop a pinch of ground shell grit off the corner. Rough going down, surprisingly bracing.
THINGS_ANT_SORTING_TABLE.pages.ABORTED.d: You clutch your deck and back off while the soldier ants snap idly at the air.
THINGS_GRUDGE_VENDING_MACHINE.title: Grudge Vending Machine
THINGS_GRUDGE_VENDING_MACHINE.loss: {character}'s portrait is now taped behind the glass of [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_GRUDGE_VENDING_MACHINE.pages.INIT:
A dented teal-iron vending cabinet stands recessed into the stone wall. Behind dusty glass hang three [gold]Potions[/gold], with a shiny chest trapped on the highest coil.

Scrawled across the slot in red paint: [red]“DO NOT KICK. I REMEMBER FACES.”[/red]

Two fresh boot-prints dent the lower panel.
Your Potion belt is full or blocked.
Gain [blue]{Kick1Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. You may kick again (it [red]holds grudges[/red]).
THINGS_GRUDGE_VENDING_MACHINE.pages.TRAY:
The coin chute clinks shut, and small bulbs flicker on behind three bottles.

“Pick one.”
THINGS_GRUDGE_VENDING_MACHINE.pages.BOUG:
A wire spiral turns smoothly and drops the bottle into the hatch.

The tiny indicator bulb blinks politely, then powers down.
THINGS_GRUDGE_VENDING_MACHINE.pages.KICK:
Your boot lands square on the dent! Coins clatter noisily into the tray.

A [red][jitter]narrow crimson eye-slit[/jitter][/red] flickers on above the glass, guarding the good stuff deeper inside.
Lose [red]{Kick2Damage}[/red] HP. Obtain a random [gold]Common Relic[/gold]. One more kick left.

You scoop up the coins and even wipe your boot-print off the steel.

The red light keeps watching you down the corridor.

You plant a second kick—and the spring-loaded cabinet bucks straight back into your shin! Still, a jarred latch drops a [gold]Common Relic[/gold] at your feet.

The red bulb flashes furiously now, with only the top [gold]Rare Relic[/gold] still hanging on.
The iron door rebounds much harder than expected, knocking you cold.
Lose [red]{Kick3Damage}[/red] HP. Obtain a [gold]Rare Relic[/gold] and become [red]Cursed[/red] — [purple]{Curse}[/purple].
Rubbing a bruised shin, you snatch the relic and limp swiftly away.

With a [red][jitter]thunderous crash[/jitter][/red], the whole machine topples forward and spills the [gold]Rare Relic[/gold] across the stones.

Inside the smashed tray, a harsh flash prints an unflattering [red]{Curse}[/red] notice straight into your deck.
The heavy iron cabinet pitches over right onto you—settling every balance.
THINGS_GRUDGE_VENDING_MACHINE.pages.COIN:
Without touching glass or steel, you fish forgotten change out of the return chute.

Inside, the red bulb never blinks.
THINGS_BLIND_CRAB_INKWELL.title: Blind Crab Inkwell
THINGS_BLIND_CRAB_INKWELL.loss: {character} dried black beside the stones at [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_BLIND_CRAB_INKWELL.soakPrompt: Choose an Attack to Enchant with Inky.
THINGS_BLIND_CRAB_INKWELL.rewritePrompt: Choose 1 non-Curse card to Transform into a random Colorless card.
An overturned celadon ink jar leaks dark indigo sheen across damp stone slabs beside a shallow rinse basin. Perched on the lip is an eyeless stone-crab wielding a soaked quill in one ink-stained claw.

Hearing your boots, it raises both pincers defensively.
No targeted Attack can be Enchanted with [purple]Inky[/purple].
Choose [blue]1[/blue] non-Curse card to [gold]Transform[/gold] into a random [gold]Colorless[/gold] card.
THINGS_BLIND_CRAB_INKWELL.pages.SOAK.des:
The crab snaps your finger sharp while you press a card flat into the pooling indigo.

When it dries, a heavy [purple]shadow[/purple] clings to the ink.
THINGS_BLIND_CRAB_INKWELL.pages.SOAK.los: Your hand slips deeper into the jar; the crab locks down and refuses to let go.
The blind crab drags wild strokes across your card and drops it into the rinse basin.

When you pull it back out, the text has rewritten itself.
THINGS_BLIND_CRAB_INKWELL.pages.RINSE.de: Leaving the crab to its calligraphy, you wash the grime off your fingers in cool water and breathe easier.
You pull back cleanly. The crab stabs at empty air with its quill and goes back to scribbling.
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.title: Chronometer Rig
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.gearPrompt: Choose a Skill to Enchant with Imbued.
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.pinPrompt: Choose a card to Enchant with Perfect Fit.
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.pages.INITIAL.des:
A ticking brass astronomical [gold]rig[/gold] stands in a Glory hall corner. Three jointed arms poise above its core: holding a glowing [blue]sapphire gear[/blue], a silver latch-pin, and a brass oil can.

Its mainspring clicks expectantly for a calibration.
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.pages.INITIAL.opt: You have no Skill eligible for [purple]Imbued[/purple].
Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP. Enchant [blue]1[/blue] card with [purple]Perfect Fit[/purple].
Your Max HP is too low.
You have no card eligible for [purple]Perfect Fit[/purple].
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.pages.GEAR.descri: You drop [gold]Gold[/gold] into the slot. The bronze pincer snaps onto your Skill and sets a blue glow deep inside its fibers.
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.pages.PIN.descrip: The silver latch-pin bites sharply into your card corner while a cold hollowness steals through your pulse. Now it remembers the top of every shuffle.
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.pages.PIN.loss: The silver pin snapped shut across your wrist, and the chronometer finally stopped.
You leave the spinning gears untouched and pocket the small brass oil flask from the pedestal step.

It sloshes with unexpected weight.
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.pages.OIL_GOLD.de: With your potion belt full, you scoop up the loose brass fittings piled beneath the pedestal instead.
THINGS_CHRONOMETER_RIG.pages.ABORTED.des: You pull your card back. The three brass arms click once into empty air and return to idling.
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.title: Silvered Gallery
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.loss: {character} vanished cleanly inside the glass of [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.duplicateRarePro: Choose a Rare card to duplicate (keeps upgrades & enchantment).
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.duplicateAnyProm: Choose a card to duplicate (keeps upgrades & enchantment).
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.pawnPrompt: Choose an Upgraded card to remove.
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.pages.INITIAL.de:
Three dusty tarnished-brass mirrors curve around a quiet gallery beside a velvet cushion holding a [gold]Rare Relic[/gold].

Across the cool quicksilver ripples, your reflection moves half a beat late.
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.pages.INITIAL.op: Lose [red]{TwinDamage}[/red] HP. Duplicate [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rare[/gold] card (keeps upgrades & enchantment).
Lose [red]{TwinDamage}[/red] HP. Duplicate [blue]1[/blue] card (keeps upgrades & enchantment).
You have no card to duplicate.
Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] Gold & [red]Remove[/red] [blue]1[/blue] Upgraded card. Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rare Relic[/gold].
No Rare Relics remain on the velvet cushion.
No removable Upgraded cards in your Deck.
Steeling yourself against the sudden chill in your ribs, you press the card onto cold glass. A ripple answers—and a second, identical copy tumbles out into your hand.
A surge of quicksilver washed across the floor and pulled the real you inside.
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.pages.PAWN.descr: You lay your polished card and coin across the velvet cushion. Your shadow reaches out to claim them, leaving the [gold]Rare Relic[/gold] gleaming in its place.
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.pages.POLISH_UPG: You wipe the tarnish from one brass frame. Reflected pale light catches a card in your satchel and leaves its edge noticeably sharper.
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.pages.POLISH_HEA: A cool silver mist drifts off the clean frame and eases the ache from your climb.
THINGS_SILVERED_GALLERY.pages.ABORTED.de: You step back from the quicksilver. All three reflections lower their hands in unison.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.title: Cracked Brazier
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.loss: {character} ended up as pale ash inside [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.temperPrompt: Choose a card to Enchant with Tezcatara's Ember.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.burnPrompt: Choose a card to burn & remove (Rare grants a Common Relic).
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.pages.INITIAL.des:
Set astride a hot geothermal crack sits a squat bronze-and-violet glass [gold]brazier[/gold], brimming with white-hot [gold]embers[/gold].

Iron tongs and two charred card scraps lie along the stone step. The fire hisses hungrily beneath its cracked panes.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.pages.INITIAL.opt: Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP and receive an [gold]Eternal[/gold] [red]{Burn}[/red]. Enchant [blue]1[/blue] card with [purple]Tezcatara's Ember[/purple].
Your Max HP is too low.
No non-X card eligible for [purple]Tezcatara's Ember[/purple].
Lose [red]{BurnDamage}[/red] HP. [red]Remove[/red] [blue]1[/blue] card; if [gold]Rare[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Common Relic[/gold].
No removable cards in your Deck.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.pages.TEMPER.desc: You clamp the card in iron tongs and plunge it straight into the white-hot coals! Heat scorches your strength away and brands your deck with an [gold]Eternal[/gold] [red]Burn[/red], yet the card lifts weightless and glowing—costing nothing and never fading.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.pages.TEMPER.loss: The hearth roared and drank down the rest of your warmth.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.pages.BURN_CARD.d: Sparks blister your knuckles as the unwanted card curls into thin ash and drifts upward.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.pages.BURN_CARD.l: A sudden flare caught your sleeve and swallowed you whole.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.pages.BURN_RARE.d: Your Rare parchment blazes gold the instant it hits the coals! Among the dying cinders gleams an intact [gold]Common Relic[/gold].
You kneel beside the bronze bowl and soak in the gentle heat until your stiff fingers loosen.
THINGS_CRACKED_BRAZIER.pages.ABORTED.des: Flame licks up toward your fingers and you pull your hand back in time.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.title: Silt Winch
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.loss: {character} was dragged under the dark water by [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.INITIAL.descript:
Bolted beside a sunken teal-lit cavern pool sits a rusted [gold]manual iron winch[/gold]. Its mud-caked hemp rope pulls taut straight down into black water.

A damp coin pouch clings to the upper knot, while something far heavier tugs gently below.
Lose [red]{Pull1Damage}[/red] HP. Pick [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Upgraded[/gold] Common/Uncommon cards.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.HAUL_1.loss: The rusted handle snapped back and knocked you straight into the pit.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.DEPTH_2.descript:
Teeth grind through silt as muddy water breaks apart around your first haul.

Down below, the rope pulls even tighter—something larger is snagging on the bottom, though the iron frame is groaning.
Lose [red]{Pull2Damage}[/red] HP. Gain [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Potion[/gold] and [blue]{Pull2Gold}[/blue] Gold, then reveal the sunken chest.
Lose [red]{Pull2Damage}[/red] HP. Gain [blue]{Pull2TotalGold}[/blue] Gold, then reveal the sunken chest.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.HAUL_2.loss: The drum spun backwards and dragged you straight across the iron gears.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.DEPTH_3.descript: With a dull thud, a black silt cloud churns up beneath the surface—just beneath it gleams the brass lock of a sunken chest, reeking of rot.
Lose [red]{Pull3MaxHp}[/red] Max HP & gain [red]Curse[/red]—[purple]{Curse}[/purple]. Gain an [gold]Uncommon[/gold] or [gold]Rare Relic[/gold].
Your Max HP is too low.
No Uncommon or Rare Relics remain below.
Let go of the winch and leave.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.HAUL_3.descripti: You heave against the bending iron bar until the heavy chest breaks the surface! You pry out its [gold]Relic[/gold]—while foul bottom-muck clings stubbornly to your satchel as [red]{Curse}[/red].
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.HAUL_3.loss: Black silt welled over the stones and pulled you beneath the pool.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.STOP_1.descripti: You wipe the mud from your hands, pocket your first haul, and walk away.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.STOP_2.descripti: Eyeballing the rotting black silt boiling up from the pit, you wisely leave the chest down below.
THINGS_SILT_WINCH.pages.CUT_POUCH.descri: You slice loose the damp coin pouch from the upper knot and leave the heavy rope undisturbed.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.loss: {character} never found a way out of [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.DEATH.description: Your knees give out. Overhead, the lights keep humming as the corridor stretches on without you.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.options.R: Your Max HP is too low.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.optio: Your Max HP is too low.
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFE: None of your cards can be Enchanted with [purple]Steady[/purple].
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.ABORTED.description: You pull your hand back from the dish. The statues watch in silence as you step away.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.title: Bilge Grate
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.loss: {character} poked the wrong toxin sac at the [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
You pass a drainage grate jammed with floating crates. [gold]Gold[/gold] and glass bottles glint between the iron bars.

Unfortunately, swollen [purple][sine]toxin sacs[/sine][/purple] are wedged right beside them. One clumsy poke and they'll burst.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.pages.INITIAL.options: Probe [blue]{FreeProbes}[/blue] times. Leave anytime; bursting a [purple]sac[/purple] deals [red]{MineDamage}[/red] damage.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.pages.SWEEP_CLEAN.des:
You steer clear of the [purple]sacs[/purple] and hook out what you can.

Not a drop on you.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.pages.SWEEP_EMPTY.des:
You stare at the swaying [purple]sacs[/purple] and pull your hook back.

Better not.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.pages.SWEEP_BURST_LOO:
[jitter]SPLORCH![/jitter]

A [purple]toxin sac[/purple] bursts right in your face. At least you already pocketed what you found.

Worth it? Hard to say.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.pages.SWEEP_BURST_EMP:
[jitter]SPLORCH![/jitter]

Your hook hits a [purple]toxin sac[/purple] almost immediately. You stumble back empty-handed.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.pages.SWEEP_BURST.los: The bursting sac knocked you straight into the canal.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.pages.SKIM_EDGE.descr:
You leave the grate alone and pry a few coins out of the planks.

Play it safe.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.ui.boardHeader: 6x6 Grate  ·  Use neighbor counts to avoid sacs
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.ui.rules: 5 caches and 6 toxin sacs below. Bursting a sac deals {MineDamage} damage and ends the search; found loot is kept.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.ui.lethalWarning: Warning: {MineDamage} HP or less—bursting a sac is fatal!
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.ui.legendGlint: 7 glinting tiles: 5 caches (including 1 Relic) and 2 sacs. Check numbers first.
THINGS_BILGE_MINES.ui.statusReady: Click a tile to probe, or right-click to flag a sac.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.title: Overgrown Rune Loom
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.selectPrompt: Choose a card to place on the slab
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.pages.INITIAL.desc:
Tangled in the roots sits a mossy [gold]stone slab[/gold] cut with square grooves. Warm sap oozes through the lines.

Hold a finger close and the sap [sine]follows[/sine] along. The brightest runes sit far apart, with thorny vines crowding the middle.

Press a card onto it and see what happens?
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.pages.INITIAL.opti: Choose [blue]1[/blue] card. Connect up to [blue]{MaxSteps}[/blue] tiles on the slab.
You have no card that can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or [gold]Enchanted[/gold].
Warm sap runs along your grooves and soaks into the card, drying into thin amber.

The slab goes dim.
You drag the sap straight through the thorny center!

[red][jitter]Thorns[/jitter][/red] slice your hand, but the card drinks in both runes.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.pages.WEAVE_MOSS.d:
The sap loops over blank moss tiles and sinks back into the dirt.

Nothing happens.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.pages.WEAVE.loss: The thorns around the slab caught your wrist and pulled you under the roots.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.pages.GATHER_SAP.d:
You ignore the runes and dab some warm sap onto your scrapes.

Feels much better.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.pages.ABORTED.desc: You pull your hand back. The sap creeps back into the cracks.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.boardHint: Click a tile to start, then adjacent tiles to extend. Click a chosen tile to step back.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.rules: Link 1–{MaxSteps} adjacent tiles. Max 1 Enchantment per card; hover any stone for details.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.summaryNoGains: Click any tile on the left to start.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.statusReady: Click any tile on the slab to start.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.statusExtended: Click a neighbor to continue, or confirm.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.rejectMaxLength: Max 4 tiles. Undo or reset first.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.rejectEnchantLi: A card can only take 1 Enchantment.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.rejectNoGold: Not enough Gold for this tile.
THINGS_MOSS_RUNE_LOOM.ui.rejectNoMaxHp: Not enough Max HP for this tile.
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.title: Clam Claw Crane
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
You find a flooded pit under a rusted iron gantry. Instead of a claw, the chain holds a collared [blue]Sewer Clam[/blue].

[gold]Gold[/gold], potions, and a [gold]sealed box[/gold] sit at the bottom. Scratched above a brass coin slot on the wall:

[sine]“Insert coin. Drop clam. Keep what it grabs.”[/sine]
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.pages.CLAW_HAUL.descrip:
The chain [jitter]ratchets[/jitter] back up. The clam reluctantly opens and spits your soaked loot into your arms.

It gurgles once, then swings back over the pit.
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.pages.CLAW_EMPTY.descri:
[jitter]CLACK![/jitter]

The clam snaps shut on nothing but dirty water and comes up empty. You shake off the spray and move on.
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.pages.LEAVE.description:
A claw machine using a live clam?

No thanks.
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.ui.controlsHint: Click the pit, button, or Space to drop. Center hits hold tight; edge grabs can slip.
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.ui.rules: Click or press Space to drop. Center hits hold firm; edge grabs can slip. 1 Relic box sits near the bottom (gold tape = Rare).
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.ui.statusReady: Wait for the clam to line up, then drop.
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.ui.statusSlipped: Slipped right back into the pit.
THINGS_CLAM_CLAW.ui.statusFinished: All grabs used. Take your loot below.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.title: Overgrown Plinko
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.loss: {character} was drained dry by the tree at [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.pages.INITIAL.descr:
A hollowed tree stands by the path. Wooden pegs line the inside above seven mossy bowls.

Warm red-gold sap leaks from the bark, looking oddly [sine][gold]hungry[/gold][/sine]. A few drops of blood harden it into [gold]Amber Seeds[/gold] that bounce down the pegs into the bowls below.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.pages.DROP.loss: The tree drank the last of your blood.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.pages.PLINKO_HAUL.d:
[sine]Clack, clack, clack...[/sine]

The bouncing stops. The mossy bowls tilt forward and slide your prizes out.

Your cut still stings, but at least it paid off.
The hollow trunk goes quiet. You press a hand to your cut and move on.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.pages.LEAVE.descrip:
Feed blood to a weird hollow tree? Pass.

You walk around it.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.ui.controlsHint: Pick a top slot and click (or Space) to drop. Glowing shrooms add +5 Gold.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.ui.rules: Click a notch or press Space to drop. Outer bowls pay bigger; glowing shrooms grant +{BumperGold} Gold. Hover any bowl for details.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.ui.summaryNone: No seeds dropped yet. Pick a slot on the left.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.ui.statusReady: Pick one of the 7 top slots and click or press Space.
THINGS_FOREST_PLINKO.ui.statusWonUpgrade: Upgraded a random card! (Bowl now gives +{Value} Gold.)
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.title: Bronze Tripod Scramble
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.pages.INITIAL.des:
A huge verdigris-crusted [gold]Bronze Cauldron[/gold] sits in the middle of the room.

You peer inside—[gold]Gold[/gold], potions, scrolls, and sealed boxes are [sine]spinning fast[/sine] around the basin!

You trade glances with your companions. Split it evenly... or count to three and grab what you can?
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.pages.INITIAL.opt: Scramble for the spinning loot. Each player gets [blue]{GrabCount}[/blue] left-click grabs.
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.pages.SHARE.descr:
Everyone holds back and divides the pile evenly.

Nobody walks away with the biggest boxes, but at least nobody starts a fight.
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.pages.SCRAMBLE_WI:
[jitter]THREE, TWO, ONE![/jitter]

Hands plunge into the cauldron at once! You clench your fist around whatever you caught and pocket it while everyone else complains.
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.pages.SCRAMBLE_EM:
When the chaos settles, you open your hand to a pinch of bronze dust.

Your companions are already counting their haul. Nobody looks your way.
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.ui.controlsHint: Track the clockwise spin with your hand; once the countdown ends, left-click to grab.
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.ui.rules: Loot spins clockwise—lead your grabs. Once the countdown ends, each player gets {Grabs} left-click grabs.
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.ui.statusCountdow: Get ready! Track the spin—left-click unlocks at zero.
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.ui.statusGo: GO! Left-click to grab what's under your palm!
THINGS_BRONZE_CAULDRON.ui.statusComplete: Time's up. Click below to take what you grabbed.
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.title: The Lending Vine
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.loss: {character} was strangled by the thorns of [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.INITIAL.descri:
A gnarled moss-draped tree blocks the woodland trail as two knotted burl-wood arms drop from above.

Before you can step back, one wooden hand plucks [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold] straight out of your deck and dangles it overhead.

[sine]"Just borrowing this one. In return, I'll brighten another card for you—fair trade, no?"[/sine]
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.INITIAL.option: No removable cards in your deck.
Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP to keep this card. The vine grabs another card.
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.PULL_0.descrip:
Thorns rake across your knuckles, yet you wrench your card back.

The old vine chuckles like creaking timber while its second hand darts in and hoists [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold] aloft.

[sine]"Oh? What about this one? Surely you'd hate to lose this one even more?"[/sine]
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.PULL_1.descrip:
Briars bite deeper as blood drips down onto the mossy roots.

No sooner do you reclaim your card than the crooked wooden fingers snap onto [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold].

[sine]"Stubborn thing. Let's see whether your blood runs dry before my bark gives out."[/sine]
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.PULL_2.descrip:
The vines cinch like iron bands while the canopy shakes with dry wooden laughter.

This time it waves [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold] right in front of your face—its thorns already slick with your blood.
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.PULL_LOOP.desc: Delighted by your stubbornness, the vine snatches yet another card and waves [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold] overhead.
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.GIVE.descripti:
You let go. Satisfied, the vine coils [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold] into a dark hollow and flicks a drop of glowing emerald sap onto your pack.

One of your cards shimmers warmly as the branches recede back into the shadows.
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.GIVE_NO_UPGRAD: You let go. The vine tucks [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold] into its hollow, mutters that nothing left in your deck can be brightened, and vanishes back into the canopy.
You jam a potion bottle into its free wooden claw. While the vine tilts its gnarled boughs to inspect the glass, you snatch your deck back and hurry down the path.
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.ESCAPE_CURSE.d: With a desperate wrench you tear free from the thicket. Your cards are intact, but stubborn tendrils cling to your wrists, leaving your hands stiff and clumsy.
THINGS_LENDING_VINE.pages.PULL.loss: The thorns bite too deep. The vine merrily waves its prize overhead as you collapse onto the moss.
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.title: Overstuffed Brood
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.loss: {character} never made it past the threshold of the [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.pages.INITIAL.d:
The Hive nursery is stifling and damp. Three swollen, semi-translucent [gold]amber brood sacs[/gold] throb in lockstep with your own heartbeat.

Through the taut membrane you can clearly see a gleaming golden core wedged among writhing larvae—while a split husk at your feet still hisses with pale acid.
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.pages.INITIAL.o: Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP. Choose [blue]1[/blue] card and add [blue]{CloneCopies}[/blue] copies of it to your deck.
Locked: Requires more than [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP and a cloneable card.
Leave immediately, taking [red]{FleeDamage}[/red] damage from bursting acid.
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.pages.REACH_COR:
Fighting down nausea, you plunge your arm elbow-deep into the hot amber sac and wrench the gleaming core free.

You got your prize—but foul dark ichor seeps straight into your pack and refuses to wipe clean.
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.pages.CLONE.des:
You press a card against the warm sac. It greedily drinks a heavy toll of your vitality, then convulses and spits out two flawless duplicates.

Pale and lightheaded, you tuck the still-warm copies away.
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.pages.CLONE.los: The brood sac drinks the last of your strength and seals you quietly inside fresh amber.
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.pages.FLEE.desc:
You slash open the blocking membrane and sprint for the exit, only for pressurized acid to burst across your back.

[jitter]HSSSS—![/jitter] You bolt out of the nursery cursing through blistered skin.
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.pages.FLEE.loss: A torrent of caustic fluid bursts straight over you before you can clear the doorway.
THINGS_OVERSTUFFED_BROOD.pages.ABORTED.d: You back away from the pulsing nursery.
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.title: Scales of Vanity
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.loss: {character} balanced the [gold]{event}[/gold] with the last of their blood.
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.pages.INITIAL.de:
Two blindfolded gilded statues stand back-to-back in a pale marble hall, hoisting an oversized, sharply tilted [gold]brass scale[/gold].

Cold lettering is chiseled across the plinth: [sine]"Too light, lose your wings. Too heavy, break your back."[/sine]

The dipped pan hangs low enough to block the corridor. Passing means weighing something on the brass—or ducking underneath.
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.pages.INITIAL.op: Lose [red]ALL[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Obtain [blue]1[/blue] Rare [gold]Relic[/gold] and [green]Remove[/green] up to [blue]{RemoveCount}[/blue] cards.
Lose [red]ALL[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Gain [blue]{FallbackGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and [green]Remove[/green] up to [blue]{RemoveCount}[/blue] cards.
Lose [red]{BloodDamage}[/red] HP. Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{OfferCount}[/blue] [green]Upgraded[/green] Rare cards to add to your deck.
[gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] random non-Basic card in your deck.
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.pages.BLOOD_WEIG: Choose 1 Upgraded Rare card to add to your deck
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.pages.EMPTY_PURS:
You invert your purse completely, showering coins until the heavy brass pan clangs into balance.

The statues incline their blindfolded heads, yielding a rare relic while burning away excess weight from your deck. Your pockets are bare, yet your step feels lighter.
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.pages.BLOOD_WEIG: You slice your palm and let blood pool into the high crimson pan. The scale levels with a resonant chime, crystallizing a honed rare technique for your choosing.
Your blood finally balances the brass beam, leaving you no strength to claim its reward.
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.pages.CRAWL_UNDE:
Unwilling to pay in coin or blood, you stoop low and crawl beneath the tilted beam.

Both blindfolded statues emit a sharp, derisive hiss. By the time you straighten up, one of your cards has warped beyond recognition.
You duck awkwardly beneath the tilted beam. The statues rasp in displeasure, finding nothing left in your deck worth twisting.
THINGS_SCALES_OF_VANITY.pages.ABORTED.de: You step back from the tilted scales.
THINGS_WALL_CRACK_LEDGER.title: The Wall-Crack Ledger
THINGS_WALL_CRACK_LEDGER.loss: {character} was dragged into the dark fissure of [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_WALL_CRACK_LEDGER.pages.INITIAL.d:
A pitch-black fissure splits the damp Depths masonry. Reaching straight out of the crack is a pale, waterlogged withered hand holding an open brass-clasped ledger dripping murky water.

Abacus beads clack briskly from inside the stone, followed by a hoarse whisper: [sine]"Take it now, principal and interest. Or... care to pawn something finer to patch yourself up?"[/sine]
THINGS_WALL_CRACK_LEDGER.pages.INITIAL.o: Gain [blue]{LoanGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Relic[/gold]. Lose [red]{LoanDamage}[/red] HP and become [red]Cursed[/red] with [blue]{CurseCount}[/blue] [red]Debt[/red].
Lose [red]{PawnRelic}[/red]. [green]Heal to full HP[/green] and obtain [blue]1[/blue] random Common [gold]Relic[/gold].
Locked: Requires a tradable Uncommon or Rare [gold]Relic[/gold].
THINGS_WALL_CRACK_LEDGER.pages.SIGN_LOAN:
You bite your thumb and stamp the soggy page in red. Coins and a wrapped relic immediately clatter out from the fissure.

Before retreating into the dark, the pale fingers twitch with a raspy chuckle: [sine]"Don't hurry off—the ledger follows you the rest of the climb."[/sine]
The instant your thumbprint dries, the cold ledger drains the last warmth from your veins.
THINGS_WALL_CRACK_LEDGER.pages.PAWN_RELI:
You place [gold]{PawnRelic}[/gold] into the cold outstretched palm. The bony fingers curl shut and slip back into the crack—sending a soothing warmth through your wounds and rolling a modest common relic to your feet.

It stings to lose a prized treasure, yet at least you're still breathing.
THINGS_WALL_CRACK_LEDGER.pages.SHOVE_BAC:
You shove the wet ledger straight back into the fissure, only for the withered nails to rake cleanly across your wrist!

Clutching the bleeding gash, you hurry down the hall to the sound of irritated abacus beads.
As you shove the ledger back, the withered hand locks onto your wrist and drags you toward the crack.
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.title: The Spiked Door
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.loss: {character} fell against the iron spikes of [gold]{event}[/gold].
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
A heavy double-leaf iron door bristling with black spikes bars your party's path. Through the narrow vertical gap, radiant [gold]golden light[/gold] pours out from a treasure vault beyond.

Dried streaks stain the lower spikes, and an overturned cup of long and short drawing straws lies on the flagstones. The door demands blood—either everyone bleeds together, or one unlucky soul gets shoved forward.
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.pages.INITIAL.options: Every player loses [red]{PushDamage}[/red] HP and obtains [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Relic[/gold].

[blue]1[/blue] random player loses [red]{ScapegoatDamage}[/red] HP and gains [red]Injury[/red], taking [blue]1[/blue] Rare [gold]Relic[/gold] and [blue]{ScapegoatGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; every other player takes no damage and gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] and [blue]{BystanderGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
Every player [red]Downgrades[/red] [blue]1[/blue] random card (or loses [red]{DetourGold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold] if none are upgraded).
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.pages.PUSH_TOGETHER.d:
[jitter]"One, two—HEAVE!"[/jitter]

Everyone throws a shoulder into the cold black spikes, forcing the vault open amid a chorus of wincing curses. Blood speckles the stone threshold, yet everyone walks off with a relic.
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.pages.PUSH_TOGETHER.l: The iron spikes bite straight through your guard. The vault swings open, but you never make it across the threshold.
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.pages.DRAW_LOTS_VICTI:
You stare down at the shortest straw—and before you can protest, your companions "helpfully" shove you straight into the spikes!

Bleeding and bruised, you burst through first and sweep the finest Rare Relic and heaviest gold sack into your own pack. [sine]If you're taking the hit, you're keeping the spoils.[/sine]
You drew the shortest straw. The heavy doors swing wide for your companions as you collapse on the spiked stones.
You breathe a quiet sigh of relief—someone else drew the short straw.

Following a pained yell at the doorway, the vault groans wide open. Unscathed, you stroll past and scoop up a spare potion and a tidy pouch of gold.
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.pages.SQUEEZE_DOWNGRA: Nobody volunteers to bleed first. Your party edges awkwardly through a jagged side crevice, scraping the sharp edge right off one of your finest cards.
THINGS_SPIKED_DOOR.pages.SQUEEZE_GOLD.de: Nobody wants to touch those spikes. Your party squeezes through a narrow side gap instead—losing a handful of loose coins to the dark stonework along the way.
